question: How many Table 2 entries use fed-batch cultivation, and how does that compare with shake flask?

trace.query: SELECT row_no, col_no, text FROM cells WHERE table_id='p9.T2' ORDER BY row_no, col_no
SELECT row_no, text FROM cells WHERE table_id='p9.T2' AND col_no=4 AND row_no>1 ORDER BY row_no
SELECT lower(text) AS mode, count(*) AS n FROM cells WHERE table_id='p9.T2' AND col_no=4 AND row_no>1 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY n DESC
SELECT row_no, col_no, text FROM cells WHERE table_id='p9.T2' AND row_no>=33 ORDER BY row_no, col_no

SELECT
 sum(CASE WHEN lower(text)='fed-batch' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fedbatch,
 sum(CASE WHEN lower(text)='shake flask' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS flask,
 sum(CASE WHEN lower(text)='fed-batch' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)-sum(CASE WHEN lower(text)='shake flask' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS diff,
 sum(CASE WHEN lower(text)='whole-cell' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wholecell,
 count(*) AS listed
FROM cells WHERE table_id='p9.T2' AND col_no=4 AND row_no>1

SELECT sum(CASE WHEN lower(text) IN ('fed-batch','shake flask','whole-cell') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS entries,
 1.0*sum(CASE WHEN lower(text)='fed-batch' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/sum(CASE WHEN lower(text) IN ('fed-batch','shake flask','whole-cell') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS frac
FROM cells WHERE table_id='p9.T2' AND col_no=4 AND row_no>1
SELECT max(CAST(t.text AS INTEGER)) AS t FROM cells t JOIN cells m ON m.table_id=t.table_id AND m.row_no=t.row_no AND m.col_no=4 AND lower(m.text)='fed-batch' WHERE t.table_id='p9.T2' AND t.col_no=5

The modes also differ in what they deliver: all prodigiosin entries are shake-flask, and the best shake-flask titer belongs to (3R)-acetoin[15] strain MG1 → MG15[16] at 39,910[17], whereas the fed-batch entries include the highest titer of the whole table, obtained with the α-bisabolol strain[18] HBQA7 → SMB19[19] at 102,300[20] in the same titer units, (mg L^(cid:0) 1)[21]. Fed-batch entries also tend to run longer, up to120[22] h, versus a maximum of108[23] h for shake-flask entries.
